Contrast Therapy

Contrast therapy means switching between heat and cold, such as a sauna and a cold plunge. The best summary, a 2013 meta-analysis, found contrast water therapy reduced muscle soreness and strength loss better than passive rest, but it was not clearly better than other recovery methods like cold water alone, compression or active recovery. If you lift for muscle size, keep the cold away from your training sessions.
